library_remove.current_snapshot: take the shared snapshot with every lock_key held in canonical order, then compare epochs and tuples
library_remove.post_unwrap_reread: a reserve or finalize that unwrapped before this writer must reread and deny after it commits
library_remove.post_audit_reread: a finalize that acknowledged intent or terminal audit before this writer must reread and deny after it commits
library_remove.linearization_point: commit of the writer transaction that moves the origin to the fenced state and closes its lease
library_remove.atomic_fence_and_outbox: fence change and secret-free outbox row commit in the same transaction; the outbox is never the fence
